title: Concept: Dependency declared as a direct registry URL
description: package.json declares a dependency written as a registry URL rather than a version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The URL bypasses the integrity value the lockfile would record and can point at a mirror that serves different content than the public registry.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The URL bypasses the integrity value the lockfile would record and can point at a mirror that serves different content than the public registry.
